description: Fine editing: line-level prose revision with meaning held fixed — condensing, rhythm, filters, nominalizations, dialogue mechanics, telling vs embodiment, voice repair. Use when the substance is right but the prose is bloated, repetitive, flat, hedged, throat-clearing, overwritten, or unclear; when the user says tighten, polish, line-edit, copyedit, make it sharper or shorter, or fix the prose without changing what it says. Changes of meaning or argument belong to writing-revise; diagnosis without edits to writing-critique.
